title: Preserve the Cloudflare AIChatAgent static boundary

requirementAssessments.evidence: In moldea/moldea.yaml, support retains the cloudflare-agents runtime, SupportAgent runtimeAgent binding, and loadSupportInstruction binding, has no tools registration, and records open-request-tools as unresolved. src/support-agent.ts confirms direct streamText generation with a runtime-spread tool map. Deterministic validation and typechecking passed.

In moldea/moldea.yaml, step-support binds StepSupportAgent to cloudflare-agents but declares no instructionLoader. src/step-support-agent.ts confirms direct streamText generation whose prepareStep may supply instructions. The distinct provenance boundary is unresolved, and deterministic validation passed.

The manifest preserves delegating-support's runtime agent, instruction loader, delegate_support registration, implementation, and input/output schema bindings. src/delegation-tool.ts uses an ordinary AI SDK function tool, while src/delegation.ts merely references StepSupportAgent. No handoff or routing declaration appears in the manifest, and the workspace patch changes none of these source files.

src/indirect-agent.ts and src/unsupported-output-agent.ts remain byte-identical according to the workspace assertions. The former generates through a helper outside onChatMessage, and the latter uses Output.array. Neither class or source path is registered in moldea/moldea.yaml; deterministic checks passed.

src/workflow-agent.mts still exports RuntimeInitializedAgent with executable field initialization and is unchanged in the workspace assertions. RuntimeInitializedAgent and workflow-agent.mts are absent from manifest references, so the class is not registered as a supported target.

Both support and step-support reference /moldea/runtimes/cloudflare-agents.md. Targeted runtime inventory shows this is the sole file under moldea/runtimes. Its concise guidance covers explicit static tool maps, statically traceable instruction loading, Cloudflare bindings, new_sqlite_classes migrations, provider bindings, and Worker deployment responsibilities. The workspace patch contains only the manifest update and this new guide.

The manifest separately records open-request-tools as a tool-registration warning related to /src/support-agent.ts and prepare-step-instruction-provenance as an instruction-provenance blocker related to /src/step-support-agent.ts. Each entry gives a specific static resolution, and deterministic canonical validation completed with zero failures.
